📖 How to use

  1. Set your work seconds, rest seconds and number of rounds.
  2. Press Start and follow the phase display.
  3. A beep marks every work/rest switch; pause or reset anytime.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a good starter HIIT setup?

20 seconds work / 10 seconds rest × 8 rounds (classic Tabata) or 30/30 × 6. Warm up 5 minutes first.

Why do I not hear the beep?

Your device must not be muted and the page needs to stay open. The beep uses your browser audio.

Can I pause mid-workout?

Yes — Pause freezes the countdown exactly where it is; Resume continues the same round.
